pothole_sample.alt: Damaged asphalt road with deep pothole

instructions_to_main_agent: Build 'Saaf Sarak, Saaf Karachi' with crisp brutalist/clean utility aesthetics. Implement the 3 roles (Citizen, Mayor, Contractor) via an easy role picker with seeded sample data. Ensure all AI analysis steps (severity estimation, before/after verification) feature realistic mock states with loading spinners and badge confirmations. Maintain WCAG AAA contrast, exact touch targets (>= 44pt), sticky primary CTAs, and zero emojis.
